summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the RDFLib SPARQL plugin. Changes: Update class added to rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now builds the prologue from the single declaration group before the empty-request early exit and returns Update(prologue, algebra) on every path; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to processor.py and exported from the sparql package __init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers the required behaviors. SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update was left unchanged because it already passes the container through. Nothing was run: tests, including the existing prepareQuery and DAWG update tests, are unverified. Not changed: the DAWG test's failure-debug path calls pprintAlgebra on the translation result, which expects a list and would misbehave there; flagged for a possible follow-up. No commit was made.
